post.summary: Reads in a single AVL report in the message body.
post.description:
Reads in a single AVL report specified by the query string parameters.

{avl: [{v: "vehicleId1", t: epochTimeMsec, lat: latitude, lon: longitude, s:speed(optional), h:heading(optional)}, {v: "vehicleId2", t: epochTimeMsec, lat: latitude, lon: longitude, s: speed(optional), h: heading(optional)}, {etc...}]

. Can also specify assignment info using "assignmentId: 4321, assignmentType: TRIP_ID" where assignmentType can be BLOCK_ID, ROUTE_ID, TRIP_ID, or TRIP_SHORT_NAME.

get.summary: Gets predictions from server

parameters.name: rs
parameters.description: List of route/stops to return predictions for. If route not specified then data will be returned for all routes for the specified stop. The route specifier is the route id or the route short name. It is often best to use route short name for consistency across configuration changes (route ID is not consistent for many agencies). The stop specified can either be the stop ID or the stop code. Each route/stop is separated by the "|" character so for example the query string could have "rs=43|2029&rs=43|3029"

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: List of stops to return predictions for. Can use either stop ID or stop code.

parameters.name: numPreds
parameters.description: Maximum number of predictions to return.
